members.statement: For the displayed 19-variable tensor A=U plus kt, A^3=U of dimension 18, U^3=W of dimension 7, mu(W,U,U)=0, the all-layer associative closure on U is M18, and the multiplication Lie algebra is sl18; the symplectic alternative is excluded by a full-rank 153-variable certificate.
members.title: The Nineteen-Variable Tensor Has an sl18 Codimension-One Core

members.statement: A dimension-minimal cubic-homogeneous collision algebra is generated by its collision midpoint and difference, has d in A^3 and dim A/A^3 at most one, every nonzero proper ideal contains d, its minimal ideal D has nonzero internal cubic product, and dim D is at least ceil((n-1)/2).
members.title: Dimension-Minimal Cubic Collision Algebras Are Monolithic

members.statement: For the minimal ideal D of a dimension-minimal cubic-homogeneous collision algebra over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field, the Lie algebra generated by partial multiplications is sl(D) or sp(D,omega).
members.title: Minimal Collision Monoliths Are sl or sp Prolongation Modules
